title.fa: لاک: حقوق طبیعی، قرارداد اجتماعی و حق مقاومت
title.en: Locke: natural rights, social contract and the right of resistance
title.nl: Locke: natuurlijke rechten, sociaal contract en recht op verzet

summary.fa: لاک در «دو رساله دربارهٔ حکومت» از حالت طبیعی با آزادی و برابری آغاز می‌کند، حکومت را قراردادی برای حفاظت از زندگی، آزادی و مالکیت می‌داند و اگر حکومت از این هدف بگذرد مردم را محق به مقاومت می‌شمارد. به همین دلیل او را از پایه‌گذاران لیبرالیسم می‌دانند.
summary.en: In the Two Treatises of Government, Locke starts from a state of nature with freedom and equality, sees government as a contract protecting life, liberty and property, and grants the people a right to resist a government that betrays that purpose. He is thus a founder of liberalism.
summary.nl: In de Two Treatises ziet Locke de overheid als contract ter bescherming van leven, vrijheid en eigendom, met recht op verzet bij machtsmisbruik.

text.fa: رسالهٔ نخست لاک ردیهٔ رابرت فیلمر و حق الاهی پادشاهان است؛ رسالهٔ دوم خاستگاه و حدود حکومت را بررسی می‌کند.
text.en: Locke's first treatise refutes Robert Filmer and the divine right of kings; the second inquires into the origin and limits of government.
text.nl: Locke's first treatise refutes Robert Filmer and the divine right of kings; the second inquires into the origin and limits of government.

text.fa: در حالت طبیعی مردم آزاد و برابرند و قانون طبیعت، که همان خرد است، به همه می‌آموزد به زندگی، تندرستی، آزادی یا دارایی دیگری آسیب نزنند.
text.en: In the state of nature people are free and equal, and the law of nature, which is reason, teaches that none should harm another's life, health, liberty or possessions.
text.nl: In the state of nature people are free and equal, and the law of nature, which is reason, teaches that none should harm another's life, health, liberty or possessions.

text.fa: چون در آن حالت هر کس داور کار خویش است، بی‌انصافی رخ می‌دهد؛ پس مردم با قراردادی اجتماعی حکومتی برپا می‌کنند که قانون وضع کند. آزادی نظریِ اولیه کم می‌شود ولی آزادی واقعی استوارتر می‌گردد.
text.en: Since everyone judges their own case there, injustice arises; people therefore form government by social contract. Original theoretical liberty is curtailed but real liberty is strengthened.
text.nl: Since everyone judges their own case there, injustice arises; people therefore form government by social contract. Original theoretical liberty is curtailed but real liberty is strengthened.

text.fa: پایهٔ اقتدار حکومت رضایت مردم است و هدفش حفاظت از زندگی، آزادی و مالکیت؛ تصمیم در جامعه با اکثریت گرفته می‌شود.
text.en: Government's authority rests on the consent of the governed and its purpose is protecting life, liberty and property; decisions within the community are taken by the majority.
text.nl: Government's authority rests on the consent of the governed and its purpose is protecting life, liberty and property; decisions within the community are taken by the majority.

text.fa: اگر حکمران از اختیار قانونی فراتر رود و حقوق شهروندان را نقض کند، با مردم در حال جنگ است و آنان حق دارند شورش کنند و از او رها شوند.
text.en: If a ruler exceeds legal authority and violates citizens' rights, he puts himself at war with the people, who have the right to rebel and be rid of him.
text.nl: If a ruler exceeds legal authority and violates citizens' rights, he puts himself at war with the people, who have the right to rebel and be rid of him.

text.fa: به روایت کتاب این اندیشه‌ها الهام‌بخش اعلامیهٔ استقلال آمریکا و انقلاب فرانسه شد؛ با آنکه رسالهٔ دوم بیشتر برای مقابله با استبداد نوشته شده بود تا توجیه انقلاب ۱۶۸۸.
text.en: The book says these ideas inspired the American Declaration of Independence and the French Revolution, although the treatise was written more against absolutism than merely to justify the 1688 revolution.
text.nl: The book says these ideas inspired the American Declaration of Independence and the French Revolution, although the treatise was written more against absolutism than merely to justify the 1688 revolution.

text.fa: دیدگاه لاک دربارهٔ مالکیت (آمیختن کار با طبیعت) و نظریهٔ قرارداد او در فصل‌های مفصل رسالهٔ دوم آمده است؛ کتاب به آن‌ها نمی‌پردازد و برای فهم دیدگاه لاک دربارهٔ مالکیت باید به متن اصلی مراجعه کرد.
text.en: Locke's theory of property (mixing labour with nature) is developed at length in the Second Treatise; this short book barely covers it, so the original text is needed to understand Locke on property.
text.nl: Locke's theory of property (mixing labour with nature) is developed at length in the Second Treatise; this short book barely covers it, so the original text is needed to understand Locke on property.

text.fa: لاک خود در تدوین «قانون اساسی بنیادین کارولینا» نقش داشت که اختیار مطلق ارباب بر برده را شامل می‌شد؛ منتقدان از همین‌رو میان آرمان آزادی او و عمل، ناهماهنگی می‌بینند.
text.en: Locke himself took part in drafting the Fundamental Constitutions of Carolina, which gave masters absolute power over slaves; critics see a tension between his liberty ideals and this practice.
text.nl: Locke himself took part in drafting the Fundamental Constitutions of Carolina, which gave masters absolute power over slaves; critics see a tension between his liberty ideals and this practice.
